criteria.description: Every elements-behaviour test imports the element modules it exercises, not the barrel
criteria.evidence: 22 files rewritten in 79c3cc2. Impact graph re-resolved for all 36 mutated sources: files per element source 30.5 -> 15.8, weighted file-runs over the 157 arms -49.5%, zero full-suite fallbacks.

criteria.description: Guard 9 rejects, by name and before any arm runs, a mutation whose subject is absent from its source's selection
criteria.evidence: Demonstrated: a scratch list pointing SC-002@sk-form-input at sk-stub.test.ts exits 1 with 'the impact graph selects no file that could carry the named test ... absent from the 15 file(s) resolved for packages/elements/src/form-input/sk-form-input.ts'. Without guard 9 the same entry reports guard 4's 'absent'.

criteria.description: selftestCeilingSeconds re-derived from CI with its basis, arm count, test count and absorbed spread stated
criteria.evidence: 1405.5 -> 1100s. Basis in suite-budget.json $comment: two CI runs of the same 157-arm / 386-assertion set at 79c3cc2 measured 844.3s and 839.8s, both on the slow runner class (1-file arms 2.21s / 2.18s). PR #241's 165 arms project to ~889s, 80.8% of 1100.

criteria.description: The cost model and before/after figures are committed
criteria.evidence: suite-budget.json carries seconds_per_arm = 2.08 + 0.233 x files_selected (slow class) and 1.17 + 0.170 x files (fast), plus two new selftestMeasurements rows recorded as a pair.

criteria.description: The browser suite's assertion multiset is identical before and after
criteria.evidence: Dumped per file and per test name before and after: 386 assertions across 38 files, all passing, byte-identical. CI: 79/79 files, ordinary suite 21.9s and 23.3s against its 40s ceiling.

criteria.description: Every arm's verdict is identical before and after
criteria.evidence: CI: 157/157 named reds with no collateral at ee1d5be (before, 1276.4s) and at 79c3cc2 (after, 844.3s and 839.8s), plus 10/10 guard self-checks. Locally the workstation produced 2-3 environmental rejections per run, never the same arms; each was re-run in isolation and passed.

criteria.description: Mean selected files per element arm below 15
criteria.evidence: 15.77 per element SOURCE, 13.52 per ARM weighted by arm count, from re-resolving the graph for all 36 sources. The per-arm figure meets the threshold; the per-source figure is 0.77 over it, and the reason is recorded: eight consumer files stay in every element arm because the generated React wrappers import the barrel (filed as #250).

criteria.description: Adding one element no longer adds test files to every existing element arm's selection
criteria.evidence: Reduced, not eliminated: 17 of the 23 behaviour tests no longer appear in another element's selection. The remaining 6 keep an in-body await import('@spec-kitty/elements') because asserting the barrel exports the registered constructor IS a claim about the barrel.
getRelevantTestSpecifications() and both its pessimistic fallbacks are untouched; the diff of scripts/suite-selftest.mjs is guard 9, four comment corrections and one report string.
No existing guard condition changed. Guard 9 is additive and pre-loop.

criteria.description: behaviours.json and the ADR-11 id set untouched
criteria.evidence: Neither file appears in the diff; config-contract.test.ts passes in both CI runs.

criteria.description: The ceiling is set from CI figures only
criteria.evidence: Both figures are CI job logs (101677273183, 101685458981). Local timings appear only as ratios.
